LanguageData.DreamCatcherDesc: A mystical device that captures dreams from sleeping pawns. Must be placed in a bedroom to function.
LanguageData.DreamLabDesc: A specialized workbench for combining dream parts into usable dream items.
LanguageData.DreamPodDesc: A specialized pod capable of transmitting dream items to other factions.
LanguageData.DreamCaptured: {0}'s dream was caught by the dream catcher!
LanguageData.CollectDreamsDesc: Collect stored dream parts from the dream catcher.
LanguageData.AnalyzeDreamsDesc: Analyze stored dream parts to gain insights.
LanguageData.LaunchDreamDesc: Launch a dream to affect another faction.
LanguageData.ResearchDreamTechnologyDesc: Learn to build Dream Catchers, allowing the collection of dream parts from sleeping colonists.
LanguageData.ResearchAdvancedDreamCraftingDesc: Build Dream Labs to combine dream parts into powerful dream items that can affect mood and inspiration.
LanguageData.ResearchDreamEngineeringDesc: Advanced dream manipulation technology allowing the construction of Dream Pods for affecting faction relations through dreams.
LanguageData.DreamEffectPositive: This dream will improve mood by {0}.
LanguageData.DreamEffectNegative: This dream will worsen mood by {0}.
LanguageData.DreamAboutFriend: The dream features someone they care about.
LanguageData.DreamAboutRival: The dream features someone they dislike.
